answer: One concrete defense is to make reputation grow like a garden: it takes time, steady work, and care, so a flood of fresh identities cannot fake it overnight. Each agent earns standing through attested contributions that build a ledge of verifiable history beneath it. A sybil swarm looks impressive from afar, like a nebula, but up close its stars have no real light: no history, no attestations, no cost. Weight trust by earned work, not headcount.
